newsitem.title: NORWAY: Elkem shuts ferrochrome plant due to weak market.
newsitem.headline: Elkem shuts ferrochrome plant due to weak market.

text.p: Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA said on Monday it was shutting down ferrochrome production at the Rana complex in northern Norway due to poor market fundamentals.

Elkem said it would close a second furnace at the 160,000 tonnes per year plant from October 1. The company shut in a 75,000 tonnes per year unit on September 1 because of the weak market. Rana has two ferrochrome furnaces.

"The ferrochrome market is characterised by market problems," Elkem said in a statement. "Prices have fallen sharply throughout 1996. The shutdown will bring Elkem Rana's stocks down to an acceptable level and help reduce the global surplus of ferrochrome stocks."
Both furnaces would remain closed until January 1, 1997, the company said.
